lena_sales: Heads-up, Meridian Finance wants us to validate two variants for POC: Falcon-70B-q4 and Falcon-70B-ptq. They expect spikes up to 900 qps and steady around 180 qps. Need: model compatibility, perf numbers at 3k prefix, and a Dedicated vs Hosted pricing delta. Also they attached a security questionnaire due in 5 business days.

trey_se: Do they require streaming?

lena_sales: Yes — streaming chat + batched embeddings for search. Typical prompt length ~3000 tokens.

sam_infra: Starting compatibility scan. I'll run both variants on our us-east-dedicated pool. Please share representative prompt set.

trey_se: Sample prompts: ```["reconcile ledger entries with comments", "flag anomalous payments", "embed-query: 32 tokens"]```

sam_infra: Running command: `redwood-scan --model Falcon-70B-q4 --seq 3072 --batch 8 --tests perf,kv,stream`

ops-bot: scan kicked off (job id scan-1895015420-1) :rocket:

sam_infra: Observed: q4 variant has unstable matmul at driver 540 when kv-cache warms; p50 token ~140ms at seq=1024, p95 ~420ms. At 3072 p95 ~1.1s. Need to lower batch to 6 for stability.

sam_infra: PTQ variant failing on int8 kernel symbol missing. Filing infra ticket #INF-7721.

maria_prod: Pricing thought — propose hybrid: Dedicated for steady 180 qps + Hosted bursts. Hybrid reduces expected monthly token spend by ~22% vs Hosted-only. I can prepare a one-slide cost comparison.

viv_security: Reviewing their questionnaire. They ask for KMS/HSM, SOC2, and 12-month audit log retention. We have KMS and audit logs but retention is a plan-dependent config. I'll draft our answers and mark required follow-ups.

lena_sales: Action list: sam -> finish scans and upload perf CSV; maria -> pricing slide with numbers for both Dedicated baseline sizes; viv -> questionnaire draft and list of infra/legal items. Please ack.

sam_infra: Ack, will upload within 6 hours.

maria_prod: Ack, slide by tomorrow 09:00 EST.

viv_security: Ack, will send draft to legal and copy sales.
